import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    b = int(input[1])
    arr = list(map(int, input[2:2+n]))
    dp = [0] * n
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    l = 0
    j = 1
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            dp[j] = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i])
            j += 1
    # sort only the relevant part of dp
    sorted_dp = sorted(dp[:j])
    for i in range(1, j):
        sorted_dp[i] += sorted_dp[i - 1]
        if sorted_dp[i] <= b:
            l = i
    print(l)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
